title: Add LiteRT export support for PyTorch backend
impact: Enabled on-device deployment of PyTorch-trained Keras 3 models via TensorFlow Lite / LiteRT.

title: Fix Attention layer hardcodes 3-D shape assumptions, breaking N-D inputs
impact: Restored N-D input support in Attention layer for transformer variants with >3D tensors.

title: Fix namespace hijacking and callable injection in deserialize_keras_object
impact: Closed a security vulnerability in model deserialization that allowed arbitrary code execution.

title: Auto-enable tf2onnx large_model for models >1.5GB
impact: Fixed ONNX export failures for large models (e.g., Gemma, LLaMA) without manual user intervention.

title: Fix Keras LiteRT export for Keras 3 + TF 2.20 + Python 3.13
impact: Restored LiteRT export compatibility across latest Keras, TensorFlow, and Python releases.

title: Fix custom models/layers with sublayers in nested lists fail to save/load weights
impact: Resolved weight serialization failures for complex nested architectures.

title: Implement KerasHub → LiteRT-LM export with prefill/decode signatures
impact: Enabling optimized on-device LLM inference with separate prefill and decode phases.

title: LiteRT export with Torch backend
impact: Extending on-device LLM coverage to PyTorch-trained KerasHub models.

title: Fix Flux model LiteRT export failures by reducing tensor dimensions
impact: Unblocked on-device deployment of Flux diffusion models via LiteRT.

title: Fix Gemma3InterleaveEmbeddings JAX inference error by ensuring indices are int32
impact: Fixed JAX-backend crash for Gemma 3 models on TPU/GPU.

title: Add guide for exporting Keras models to LiteRT
impact: Official documentation adopted as canonical reference for Keras → LiteRT export.

title: Preserve dict keys in flat_arg_names for positional args
impact: Improving API usability when converting PyTorch models with dictionary inputs to LiteRT.
